answer: Each agent must harbor a hardware-rooted enclave key bound to a remote-attestation quote, so a sable pseudonym cannot be cloned across hosts without revealing a shared silicon fingerprint. Peers verify zero-knowledge proofs of enclave freshness before admitting new identities, forcing any attacker to forge a distinct attested root per sybil rather than replaying one. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
